```{r, include=FALSE} 
require("png")
require("dplyr")
library("tidyverse")
require("grid")
require("tibble")
require("knitr")
require("extrafont")
require("ggrepel");
require("gridExtra")
require("contrast")
require("vegan")
require("scales")

calc.titer <- function(Plaques, Dilution, Plating) {
  # Ensure plaques and dilution are the same length
  if (length(Plaques) != length(Dilution)) {
    stop("Plaques and Dilution vectors must have the same length")
  }
  
  # Compute titer
  titer <- (Plaques / (10^(-Dilution) * Plating)) * 1000

  return(mean(titer))
}

```

Graphing
```{r}
all<- data.frame(strain, rep1, rep2, rep3, rep4)
all$average<-rowMeans(all[, c("rep1", "rep2", "rep3", "rep4")])
all$sd <- apply(all[, c("rep1", "rep2", "rep3", "rep4")], 1, sd)

ex1<-data.frame(all$strain, all$rep1, all$rep2)
ex1$average<-rowMeans(ex1[, c("all.rep1", "all.rep2")])
ex1<-data.frame(all$strain, all$rep3, all$rep4)
ex1$average<-rowMeans(ex2[, c("all.rep3", "all.rep4")])

ggplot(all, aes(x = strain, y = average)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = average - sd, ymax = average + sd), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Virospore formation in sporulation gene knockout mutants",
       x = "Strain",
       y = "Virospore Titer (vPFU/mL)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ex1, aes(x = strain, y = average)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scientific_format()) +
  labs(title = "Virospore formation in sporulation gene knockout mutants",
       x = "Strain",
       y = "Virospore Titer (vPFU/mL)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(ex2, aes(x = strain, y = average)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", width = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Virospore formation in sporulation gene knockout mutants",
       x = "Strain",
       y = "Virospore Titer (vPFU/mL)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("20250711_Virospores.png", plot=vPFU, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
